kcat_provenance.method: pFBA (parsimonious_reference_flux, two scipy HiGHS LPs) on the GEM box capped by enzyme-capacity ceilings (variant point, kcat sigma_k 0.0, capacity scale 3000, 995 reactions ceilinged from the Messner 2023 wild-type proteome); gene deleted through cobra.manipulation.knock_out_model_genes; written by ess_kcat_bounded_store.py

media_report.recipe: YPD-approx (YNB + 20 amino acids + uracil + adenine; peptone NOT modeled)
media_report.provenance: see the recipe's docstring in torchcell/metabolism/media.py

kcat_provenance.scale_rule: the smallest scale on the calibration grid at which the wild type (the median over draws, for sampled) reaches at least 0.9 of its unconstrained pFBA growth; the un-scaled box was measured infeasible in results/capacity_calibration_predicted.json

proteome.conversion: total protein approach: E_g = (MaxLFQ_g / sum over detected proteins of MaxLFQ) x P_tot / MW_g, with MaxLFQ the mean over the non-missing HIS3 wild-type columns, P_tot from GECKO3_YEAST_PROTEIN_POOL and MW_g from SwissProt (kDa). The denominator spans the detected proteins only, so every fraction overstates its share by the undetected mass.

kcat_provenance.ceiling_rule: ceiling_j = sum over units u of reaction j of kcat_u[1/s] x 3600 x E_u[mmol/gDW], E_u = min over the unit's member genes of the measured abundance, defined only when every member gene is measured; a reaction takes a ceiling only when every one of its units has an abundance, else it keeps the GEM bound; applied as ub <- min(ub, scale x ceiling) and lb <- max(lb, -scale x ceiling)
